t: A prayer with two halves that seem to contradict
a: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي شَهَادَةً فِي سَبِيلِكَ، وَاجْعَلْ مَوْتِي فِي بَلَدِ رَسُولِكَ
p: Allāhumma-rzuqnī shahādatan fī sabīlik, wa-jʿal mawtī fī baladi rasūlik.
m: O Allah, grant me martyrdom in Your cause, and make my death be in the city of Your Messenger.
